title: Button: Button sizes (daisyUI)
notes:
Buttons allow the user to take actions or make choices.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/button/+page.md
code:
<button class="btn btn-xs">Xsmall</button>
<button class="btn btn-sm">Small</button>
<button class="btn">Medium</button>
<button class="btn btn-lg">Large</button>
<button class="btn btn-xl">Xlarge</button>
